final: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_ambient_temp, AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_image_count, AVG(se.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM scanenvironment WHERE imgcount IS NOT NULL) as imgcount_diff_from_overall FROM scanenvironment se JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat
